text:
Maya Singh: Quick follow-up from today1: can we capture single-line owners + realistic rollout windows for API perf, Console UX rewrite, and Optimize cost recommendations? Want to include in the all-hands digest.

Tom Becker: Eng: API perf split into small, measurable changes. Kernel/autotune canary mid-July, GA goal by first week of Aug. KV improvements likely Sept but still experimental.

Ruth Almeida: Product: Console rewrite is on track for a developer beta in late Oct; public beta around mid-Nov. UX will graduate to GA in early Q1 next year.

Alex Chen: Applied ML: Optimize recommendations v1 internal trials Sept, selected customers Oct, GA targeted end of Nov. Need evaluation harness and sample prompts.

Maya Singh: Can each owner put one critical dependency here? Also, list any blockers for Dedicated/Private customers (config differences).

Tom Becker: Dependency: need kernel perf numbers on the latest CUDA/runtime and a staging fleet with mixed model traffic. Blocker: Dedicated pools need a safe rollback flag for older FW.

Ruth Almeida: Dependency: design signoff on a migration modal and docs writer. Blocker: Private deploys may need a docs snippet for air-gapped installs (install hooks).

Alex Chen: Dependency: labeled prompt sets + eval metrics for recommendation precision. Blocker: offline telemetry from Private customers may not be available for automated suggestions.

Maya Singh: GTM concerns?

GTM-bot: Reminder: Please submit a short product one-pager into #marketing by 2025-06-30 for sales enablement.

Ruth Almeida: Actionable owner map for the email: API perf -> Tom Becker (eng) 1: July canary / Aug GA.

Ruth Almeida: Console rewrite beta -> Ruth Almeida (product) 1: closed beta late Oct / public beta mid-Nov.

Alex Chen: Optimize v1 -> Alex Chen (Applied ML) 1: internal Sept / customer trials Oct / GA end-Nov.

Tom Becker: Runbook + rollback owner: Tom Becker (eng-sre). I'll publish playbooks and canary dashboards by 2025-06-26.

Maya Singh: Nice. Last ask: drop one tiny sample config we can paste into the customer FAQ for Dedicated (just a snippet).

Tom Becker: sample (dedicated):
```json
{"batching_mode":"adaptive","kv_persist":false,"max_latency_ms":150}
```

Ruth Almeida: I'll draft FAQ + migration checklist and ping docs.

Alex Chen: I'll assemble eval prompts and a measurement plan; ping me for early trials.

Maya Singh: Thanks everyone 1: I'll consolidate and send the all-hands follow-up email this afternoon and schedule a 15m dependency sync for early next week. :rocket:
